Server.Name: Doom Survival (Classic Doom)
Server.Description:
What would it be like if Classic Doom was an open world survival sandbox game? The demons from hell have invaded Earth, most people are dead or escaped into space, traders included, and DoomGuy wants revenge on the demons for murdering his pet rabbit, Daisy.
Features: - No stamina: sprint and jump as much as you desire. - Armour is now a stat that works together with your health to absorb a portion of the damage. But if destroyed, you'll be taking full damage. - Equalised damage: shooting a demon in their hand or their face deals the same damage. - 360 sprinting: you can sprint in any direction you desire. - No reloading: you'll never need to reload your guns. With a few exceptions, while the Crossbow and Super Shotgun automatically reload after firing, the Junk Turret needs to reload as it is it's own unit. - Biome specific loot: you can't get all the goodies in the forest, you have to face the invasion in tougher biomes, but make sure you're geared up first. - Monster infighting: demons are chaotic and will fight to kill their fellow demons if another demon harms them. - Custom sandbox options: your Doom experience can be customised using new options specific to the mod. (Your vanilla codes will break the mod) - Your weapons: Knuckles, Knife, Chainsaw, Primitive Bow, Handgun, Pump Shotgun, Compound Crossbow, Junk Turret, Flamethrower, Chaingun, Super Shotgun, Rocket Launcher, Plasma Rifle, Big Fucking Gun. - Optional content: if you're feeling nostalgic, you can visit 68 Classic Doom levels from both Doom and Doom II. You just need to find a way to get there.
- For those playing multiplayer! The new v2.0.0 has optional content, 7 days to die has a spawn limit of 64, and this optional content will use up this limit for a single player if they play with this content, this means there will be no spawns for anyone else. In the future there may be an update that increases this limit so the optional content is more multiplayer friendly.
- Sandbox settings! Doom Survival has it's own custom sandbox settings, so your saved vanilla codes ARE NOT supported. Create a new one to ensure you're playing with the intended available options.
- What map should I use? The Random World Generation has modifications, increasing how many POI's spawn, so generate a new world, preferably using the 'Advanced Generation' option.
- I spawned next to another biome. It is recommended to stay away from other biomes, until you have enough gear to take on another biome.
